// Marker corpus for //dross:taint-cleared (TestTaintMarkerCorpus). A marker
// binds the line directly below it and clears only the tainted values defined
// there. Two lines up, it binds the wrong line and is an orphan; the
// exec-exempt directive in the same slot clears nothing; the raw stream beside
// a cleared conversion still trips; and a marker sitting on the stream itself —
// the spawn's output, the writer plugged into Cmd.Stdout, a pipe — is a
// "marker on source" finding that clears nothing.
package markers

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

func twoLinesAbove(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	//dross:taint-cleared a trimmed SHA is forty hex digits, never prose
	_ = len(out) // WANT marker
	sha := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	return errors.New(sha) // WANT taint
}

func directlyAbove(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	//dross:taint-cleared a trimmed SHA is forty hex digits, never prose
	sha := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	fmt.Println("resolved")
	return errors.New("bad sha: " + sha)
}

func wrongDirective(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	//dross:exec-exempt a trimmed SHA is forty hex digits, never prose
	sha := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	return errors.New(sha) // WANT taint
}

func sideways(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	//dross:taint-cleared a trimmed SHA is forty hex digits, never prose
	sha := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	return fmt.Errorf("sha %s from %s", sha, out) // WANT taint
}

func orphan() error {
	//dross:taint-cleared blanket-marking a file must not pass unnoticed
	msg := "fixed prose" // WANT marker
	return errors.New(msg)
}

func onOutput(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	//dross:taint-cleared marking the stream itself would launder all of it
	out, _ := c.Output() // WANT marker
	return errors.New(string(out)) // WANT taint
}

func onStdout(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	//dross:taint-cleared marking the plug-in point would launder the stream
	c.Stdout = &buf // WANT marker
	_ = c.Run()
	return errors.New(buf.String()) // WANT taint
}

func onPipe(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	//dross:taint-cleared marking the pipe would launder every line read from it
	r, _ := c.StdoutPipe() // WANT marker
	b, _ := io.ReadAll(r)
	return errors.New(string(b)) // WANT taint
}
